Subject: Follow-up from today — DPA, SCC module & next steps

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo this morning — helpful walkthrough. Our legal team asked me to follow up on a few compliance items so we can move the procurement conversation along:

1) Can you send your standard DPA (processor-side) for our review? We prefer a redline-ready PDF.
2) For international transfers, which SCC module does Redwood typically propose when Redwood acts as a processor? Please indicate the module name/number and a short rationale.
3) What's your current SOC 2 status and expected timing if there is an upcoming report?
4) We need to initiate our vendor security questionnaire (VSQ). Can you confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire and whether you have an internal questionnaire to return?

If you could get the DPA and a short note on SCC choice over to legal by EOD tomorrow that would be great. I can loop in our procurement lead after we have those docs.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — DPA, SCC module & next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Neha (legal lead) and Priyom (security/SE) to help with the specifics. High-level answers and next steps below; see attachments for the draft DPA and a short SCC options summary.

High-level:
- DPA: Redwood acts as a data processor for typical SaaS use cases. Attached is our standard DPA (Redwood-DPA-draft-20260407.pdf) which is redline-ready.
- SCC: When Redwood is acting as a processor, we generally recommend the SCC "Processor Module" (Module 2 in the latest EU SCC framework summary). The SCC-module-options-summary.xlsx attached outlines the scenarios and why Module 2 maps to our role. If you expect controller-to-controller transfers, we can discuss a different module but that is uncommon for our integration.
- SOC 2: We maintain an active SOC 2 Type II program. The most recent Type II period closed 2025-12-31; we can share the report under NDA or as part of an enterprise package. If you need a statement earlier, Priyom can provide a summary of scope and controls.
- Vendor questionnaire: Priyom will own returning your VSQ. If you can drop the questionnaire link or spreadsheet we will complete it; for longer questionnaires we typically ask for a 5-business-day turnaround for full answers and evidence.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) I attached Redwood-DPA-draft-20260407.pdf and SCC-module-options-summary.xlsx for your legal team to review.
2) Priyom, please own the VSQ and provide a subprocessors list (we'll attach a current CSV).
3) Neha, please propose any boilerplate redlines we see frequently on the DPA so Elena's team has a starting point.

If it helps, happy to schedule a 30-minute legal sync this week to walk legal through the DPA + SCC module choice. Suggested times: Thu 10:00–11:00am ET or Fri 9:00–10:00am ET.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0146

Thanks Aditya — received the attachments and shared with legal. A couple of clarifying questions from our counsel:

- Controller vs Processor: We want explicit language confirming Redwood will be a processor and will act only on CyberFin's instructions. Can you point to the DPA section that covers that and confirm you are comfortable with that language?
- Data deletion: our policy requires vendors to delete customer data within 60 days of contract termination (unless otherwise required by law). Will Redwood accept a 60-day deletion window in the DPA?
- Subprocessors: Please provide a current list of subprocessors and indicate which ones are used for backups, monitoring, and model inferencing. (If you have a hosted cloud provider link or a CSV, that would be ideal.)
- SOC 2: legal has asked for confirmation whether the 2025 Type II report is comprehensive for production and inference runtime. If not, please detail what scope gaps exist.

Also — we have a standard VSQ (link below). Can Priyom pick this up? If possible, we'd like to get the answered questionnaire back within 5 business days so procurement can proceed.

Link: https://vendorforms.cyberfin.com/vsq/CF-2026-015

Would you be available for the legal sync Friday 9:00am ET? If so I'll send a calendar invite and include our legal counsel.

Cheers,
Elena

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 10:05:04 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — DPA, SCC module & next steps

Elena —

Thanks — answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

- Controller vs Processor: Confirmed. Section 1 ("Roles and Responsibilities") of the attached DPA states: "Redwood Inference acts as a Data Processor and will process Personal Data only on documented instructions from the Controller." Neha and I have reviewed that language and we are comfortable; if CyberFin requires specific phrasing, we can add an explicit line in the signature block.

- Data deletion: We can accept a 60-day deletion window for customer data post-termination, subject to legal review. We'll populate Section 6 (Data Retention and Deletion) with the 60-day term in the redline.

- Subprocessors: Current subprocessors are listed at https://redwood.ai/legal/subprocessors-2026-04-07 and I attached a quick CSV (subprocessors-20260407.csv) showing vendor name, region, and primary function. Short summary: primary cloud provider (compute & storage), a monitoring provider (logs/metrics), and a CDN partner (edge). Model-hosting and inferencing are done in our managed runtime layer on top of the cloud provider — inferencing functions are not pushed to unknown third parties beyond our approved infra partners. We'll include purpose tags in the CSV to make it clearer.

- SOC 2: The 2025 Type II report covers production systems and the inference runtime scope. Priyom: can you add two sentences to the DPA appendix stating the SOC 2 scope covers production inference and log collection? If we need to share the full report, we'll do so under the usual confidentiality request.

Next steps/action owners:
1) Priyom - complete the CyberFin VSQ at https://vendorforms.cyberfin.com/vsq/CF-2026-015 within 5 business days and attach evidence where available.
2) Neha - add the 60-day deletion clause in Section 6 and prepare suggested redlines for quick review.
3) Aditya - schedule the legal sync for Fri 09:00–09:30am ET; will send calendar invite to Elena + CyberFin Legal.

Proposed DocuSign flow: once legal agrees on Module 2 SCC + DPA redlines, Redwood can prepare the SCC Annex and send for signature via DocuSign (sample link: https://docusign.com/example/CF-RD-2026).

If any of the CyberFin legal team wants to join a brief pre-call with Priyom to go over the VSQ evidence items, we're happy to set 15 minutes Thursday afternoon.

Best,
Aditya Rao
